blocks.text: Organic chemistry mein structural unit >C=O ko carbonyl group kehte hain. Aldehydes aur ketones compounds ki woh classes (qismein) hain jin mein carbonyl group hota hai. Aldehydes aur ketones ke general structures (aam banawat) neeche diye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Aam banawatein: R-C(=O)-H (Aldehydes) aur R-C(=O)-R (Ketones), dono mein O carbonyl carbon ke oopar double bond se.
blocks.caption: Aldehydes aur ketones ki aam banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 102 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono mein C=O group hai. Aldehyde mein carbonyl carbon ke saath kam az kam aik H atom laga hota hai (R–CHO). Ketone mein carbonyl carbon ke dono taraf carbon groups (R aur R) hote hain (R–CO–R).

Yeh compounds qudrat (nature) mein bohat paye jate hain aur har saal bari miqdar mein banaye (synthesise kiye) jate hain. Aldehydes bohat se masalon (spices), phalon aur qudrati khushbuon (natural fragrances) mein hote hain. Ketones dawaon (pharmaceuticals), chemicals aur paint ki industries mein istemal hote hain. Sab se aam ketone acetone hai, jo nail polish remover mein hota hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat (Interesting Information)
blocks.text: Kadwe badam (bitter almond) ki boo aur zaiqa benzaldehyde ki wajah se hai. Acetone (propanone) nail polish remover mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke badam ka benzaldehyde terpenes ki oxidation se banta hai. Yeh durust nahi: kadwe badam mein benzaldehyde amygdalin naam ke compound ki hydrolysis (paani se tootna) se nikalta hai, terpenes se nahi.

blocks.alt: Benzaldehyde: benzene ring par CHO group, C ka O se double bond aur neeche H. Acetone (propanone): C ke oopar O double bond se, neeche H3C aur CH3, label 'Acetone (Propanone)'.
blocks.caption: Dilchasp maloomat ke dabbe se benzaldehyde aur acetone (propanone) (kitab ke PDF safha 102 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Aldehyde aur ketone mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Aldehyde mein carbonyl carbon par kam az kam aik hydrogen hota hai (RCHO); ketone mein carbonyl carbon do carbon groups se jura hota hai (RCOR').

items: Aldehyde R–CHO (C=O par H); ketone R–CO–R (do carbon groups).
Misalein: benzaldehyde (kadwe badam), acetone (nail polish remover).
